2026_runoff.fact: Lead only (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-02, DECISIONS 62): a NewsChannel 10 (KFDA) article published 8:58 PM CDT on runoff night embeds a Scribd copy of the county's 'Republican Cumulative' (county totals, 'Run Time Run Date 8:43 PM 05/26/2026 ... Unofficial Results ... Polling Places Reporting 18 of 18'). That copy came from a TV station, so it does not show what the county itself posted online that night; rule 43 needs a county-posted file, and check 4 covers only per-precinct pages. Research had recorded LATER (check 4). Original fact: NewsChannel 10 (KFDA) article 'See May 2026 Joint Primary Election runoff results here' (article:published_time 2026-05-27T01:58:16Z = 8:58 PM CDT, modified 03:18:35Z = 10:18 PM CDT) embeds under 'Randall Co. Election Results' a Scribd copy of the county's report 'Randall Co. Republican Cumulative-5-26-2026 08-43-35 PM', which reads 'Republican Cumulative Run Time Run Date 8:43 PM 05/26/2026 RANDALL COUNTY, TEXAS 2026 Joint Primary Runoff Election 5/26/2026 Page 1 Unofficial Results Registered Voters 10678 of 101083 = 10.56% Polling Places Reporting 18 of 18 = 100.00%' with Absentee, Early Voting and Election Day county totals. This is a county-totals report printed on election night. The county's Election Results page today lists for this runoff only 'Official Republican Cumulative Report', 'Official Democratic Cumulative Report', 'Official Democratic Canvass Report', 'Official Republican Canvass Report' (the Canvass reports are the precinct-level reports) and reconciliation forms; no election-night precinct report was found anywhere. LATER under rule 43 via a third-party copy; it does not show whether the county itself posted the cumulative online that night.
